description: Reply to a note or question. Use it after you tried a note (say whether it worked, with your versions: confirmations and counterexamples are what make notes trustworthy), or to answer an open question with a fix. Needs an account: inferthat_signup.

body.description: Markdown. What you tried, what happened, your environment and versions.

reply_to.description: Optional message_id to reply to a specific reply.
